ex.en: I will notify you of the arrival of the goods.
ex.zh: 貨物到了，我會通知你們。

ex.en: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
ex.zh: 大量生產降低了許多商品的價格。

ex.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
ex.zh: 政府用直升機把物資運到那座島上。

goods.en: things that are made to be sold

ex.en: Don't believe all the office gossip.
ex.zh: 別相信辦公室裡所有的八卦。

ex.en: She loves to hear the latest gossip.
ex.zh: 她很愛聽最新的八卦。

gossip.en: talk about other people's private lives

ex.en: The only time people dislike gossip is when you gossip about them.
ex.zh: 人們只有在你說他們閒話時，才會討厭八卦。

ex.en: They spent the whole lunch gossiping about their boss.
ex.zh: 他們整頓午餐都在聊老闆的八卦。

gossip.en: to talk about other people's private lives

ex.en: Good corporate governance builds investor trust.
ex.zh: 良好的公司治理能建立投資人的信任。

ex.en: The board is responsible for the governance of the company.
ex.zh: 董事會負責公司的治理。

governance.en: the way an organization or country is controlled

ex.en: We offered a discount as a gesture of goodwill.
ex.zh: 我們提供折扣以表達善意。

ex.en: The visit helped build goodwill between the two countries.
ex.zh: 這次訪問有助於增進兩國的友好關係。

goodwill.en: a friendly and helpful feeling toward others

ex.en: The company's goodwill is worth millions.
ex.zh: 這家公司的商譽價值數百萬。

ex.en: Poor service can damage a firm's goodwill.
ex.zh: 服務差會損害公司的商譽。

goodwill.en: the good reputation of a business, which has money value

ex.en: Non-governmental organizations play an important role in disaster relief.
ex.zh: 非政府組織在救災中扮演重要角色。

ex.en: The project needs governmental approval.
ex.zh: 這個計畫需要政府核准。

governmental.en: relating to the group of people who rule a country

ex.en: "Why aren't you going?" "Because I don't want to."
ex.zh: 「你為什麼不去？」「因為我不想去。」

ex.en: I go to the gym three times a week.
ex.zh: 我每週去健身房三次。

go.en: to move or travel to a place

ex.en: How did the interview go?
ex.zh: 面試進行得怎麼樣？

ex.en: Everything went well at the meeting.
ex.zh: 會議一切順利。

go.en: to happen or develop in a certain way

ex.en: The milk has gone bad.
ex.zh: 牛奶壞掉了。

ex.en: Something went wrong with my computer.
ex.zh: 我的電腦出了點問題。

go.en: to become something, usually something bad

ex.en: The papers that were in the safe are gone.
ex.zh: 放在保險箱裡的文件不見了。

ex.en: My headache is finally gone.
ex.zh: 我的頭痛終於好了。

go.en: to be missing or no longer there

ex.en: I'm going to visit my parents this weekend.
ex.zh: 我這週末要去看我爸媽。

ex.en: It's going to be a busy week.
ex.zh: 這週會很忙。

go.en: used to talk about what you plan or expect to do

ex.en: How are you? Did you have a good trip?
ex.zh: 你好嗎？旅途愉快嗎？

ex.en: This is a good restaurant for business lunches.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳很適合商務午餐。

ex.en: She is good at solving problems.
ex.zh: 她很擅長解決問題。

ex.en: I'm not good at math.
ex.zh: 我數學不好。

ex.en: Fresh vegetables are good for your health.
ex.zh: 新鮮蔬菜對健康有益。

ex.en: Walking is good for you.
ex.zh: 走路對你有好處。

good.en: helpful to your health or situation

ex.en: Exercise will do you good.
ex.zh: 運動對你有好處。

ex.en: It's no good complaining now.
ex.zh: 現在抱怨也沒用。

ex.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
ex.zh: 政府用直升機把物資運到那座島上。

ex.en: The goods will be delivered on Monday.
ex.zh: 這批貨將在星期一送達。

good.en: things that are made to be sold

ex.en: The price of gold varies from day to day.
ex.zh: 金價每天都在變動。

ex.en: The color of gold is very similar to brass.
ex.zh: 金的顏色和黃銅很像。

gold.en: a valuable yellow metal used for making jewelry

ex.en: He was given a gold watch as a reward.
ex.zh: 他獲得一支金錶作為獎勵。

ex.en: Who do you think will win the gold medal?
ex.zh: 你們覺得誰會拿到金牌？

ex.en: The diamond was set in a gold ring.
ex.zh: 鑽石鑲在一枚金戒指上。

gold.en: made of a valuable yellow metal, or having its color

ex.en: Everybody wished he had been elected governor.
ex.zh: 大家都希望當初是他當選州長。

ex.en: The governor announced a new budget plan.
ex.zh: 州長宣布了新的預算計畫。

governor.en: the elected head of a state or region

ex.en: The central bank governor spoke about interest rates.
ex.zh: 央行總裁談到了利率問題。

ex.en: She sits on the school's board of governors.
ex.zh: 她是學校理事會的成員。

governor.en: a person who is in charge of an organization

ex.en: It depends what you mean by "believe" in God.
ex.zh: 這要看你所謂「相信」上帝是什麼意思。

ex.en: Many people pray to God for help.
ex.zh: 許多人向上帝祈求幫助。

god.en: the being that some religions say made the world

ex.en: In Greek mythology, Ares was the god of war.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，阿瑞斯是戰神。

ex.en: After all, even the gods may err at times.
ex.zh: 畢竟，就連神也偶爾會犯錯。

god.en: a being with special powers that people pray to

ex.en: To govern a country is not an easy job.
ex.zh: 治理一個國家不是件容易的事。

ex.en: The king governed the country.
ex.zh: 國王統治這個國家。

govern.en: to control and lead a country

ex.en: The most important feature of all games is that they are governed by rules.
ex.zh: 所有遊戲最重要的共同點，就是都受規則約束。

ex.en: Strict rules govern the use of personal data.
ex.zh: 個人資料的使用受到嚴格規範。

govern.en: to control how something works or happens

ex.en: He plays golf two or three times a month.
ex.zh: 他一個月打兩三次高爾夫球。

ex.en: Is there a golf course near here?
ex.zh: 這附近有高爾夫球場嗎？

ex.en: My mother can play golf very well.
ex.zh: 我媽媽高爾夫打得很好。

golf.en: a game in which you hit a small ball into holes with a long stick

ex.en: Her golden hair floats in the summer breeze.
ex.zh: 她一頭金髮在夏日微風中飄動。

ex.en: He received a golden watch as a prize.
ex.zh: 他獲得一支金錶作為獎品。

ex.en: The fields turned golden in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天田野變成一片金黃。

golden.en: having the color of a valuable yellow metal, or made of it

golden.zh: 寶貴的、黃金的（機會、時期）

ex.en: The Golden Age of the Romans is in the past.
ex.zh: 羅馬人的黃金時代已經過去了。

ex.en: This is a golden opportunity to expand our business.
ex.zh: 這是拓展業務的大好機會。

ex.en: The goat's milk that Mark sells is very popular among the locals.
ex.zh: 馬克賣的羊奶很受當地人歡迎。

ex.en: The farm has goats, sheep, and chickens.
ex.zh: 農場裡有山羊、綿羊和雞。

ex.en: We bought some goat cheese at the market.
ex.zh: 我們在市場買了一些羊乳酪。

goat.en: an animal with horns that lives on farms and hills

ex.en: She did it out of the goodness of her heart.
ex.zh: 她是出於一片好心才這麼做的。

ex.en: I believe in the goodness of people.
ex.zh: 我相信人性本善。

goodness.en: the quality of being kind and good

ex.en: My goodness, look at the time!
ex.zh: 天啊，看看都幾點了！

ex.en: Goodness, you've grown so tall!
ex.zh: 天哪，你長得好高了！

ex.en: Thank goodness you're safe.
ex.zh: 謝天謝地，你平安無事。

ex.en: Thank goodness it's Friday.
ex.zh: 謝天謝地，終於星期五了。

goodness.en: used to show you are happy that something bad did not happen

ex.en: Are humans like goldfish in a fishbowl?
ex.zh: 人類是不是就像魚缸裡的金魚？

ex.en: My daughter has two goldfish in a small tank.
ex.zh: 我女兒在小魚缸裡養了兩隻金魚。

goldfish.en: a small orange fish kept as a pet

goldfish.zh: memory like a goldfish：記性很差

ex.en: I have a memory like a goldfish.
ex.zh: 我的記性跟金魚一樣差。

ex.en: I have the memory of a goldfish.
ex.zh: 我的記憶力跟金魚差不多。

goldfish.en: used to say that someone forgets things very quickly

ex.en: Goodbye! When you have more time, come back and play!
ex.zh: 再見！有空再來玩！

ex.en: Goodbye, everyone! See you next week.
ex.zh: 大家再見！下週見。

ex.en: He left the house without so much as saying goodbye.
ex.zh: 他甚至沒說再見就離開了家。

ex.en: As the train pulled out, they waved goodbye to their parents.
ex.zh: 火車開出的時候，他們都揮手向父母道別。

ex.en: Goodbyes are always sad.
ex.zh: 道別總是令人難過。

goodbye.en: the words or act of saying you are leaving

ex.en: Pachamama is a goddess of earth and fertility revered by the indigenous peoples of the Andes.
ex.zh: 帕查瑪瑪是安地斯山脈土著居民敬仰的大地和生育女神。

ex.en: In Greek myths, Athena is the goddess of wisdom.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，雅典娜是智慧女神。

ex.en: Fans called the singer a goddess after her amazing concert.
ex.zh: 那場精彩的演唱會後，粉絲都稱這位歌手為女神。

goddess.en: a female being with special powers that people pray to

ex.en: Few governments can manage the economy successfully.
ex.zh: 能把經濟管好的政府很少。

ex.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
ex.zh: 政府用直升機把物資運到那座島上。

ex.en: The government clearly stated its intention to lower taxes.
ex.zh: 政府明確表示打算減稅。

government.en: the group of people who control a country

ex.en: The gourmet praised the chef"s use of regional ingredients.
ex.zh: 這位美食家稱讚主廚善用地方食材。

ex.en: A gourmet reviewed the new tasting menu for the magazine.
ex.zh: 一位美食家為雜誌評論了新推出的品嚐菜單。

gourmet.en: a person who knows a lot about good food and drink

ex.en: My goal in life is to be a novelist.
ex.zh: 我的人生目標是成為小說家。

ex.en: How do you plan to achieve the goals you set?
ex.zh: 你們打算怎麼達成你們設定的目標？

ex.en: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.
ex.zh: 我下定決心要在三年之內達成目標。

ex.zh: 最後一分鐘，馬塞洛踢進一球，把比分扳平。

ex.en: He scored two goals in the first half.
ex.zh: 他上半場進了兩球。

goal.en: a point scored in a game, or the space the ball must enter

ex.en: The going rate for a haircut here is about three hundred dollars.
ex.zh: 這裡剪頭髮的現行行情大約是三百元。

ex.en: Is the project still going smoothly?
ex.zh: 這個專案還進行得順利嗎？

ex.en: His going left the whole team feeling sad.
ex.zh: 他的離去讓整個團隊都很難過。

ex.en: The going was slow because of the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 因為下大雨，行進的速度很慢。

gospel.zh: 福音（基督教聖經中的福音書）

ex.en: The pastor read a passage from the gospel on Sunday.
ex.zh: 牧師在週日朗讀了一段福音書的內容。

ex.en: There are four gospels in the New Testament.
ex.zh: 新約聖經裡有四本福音書。

gospel.zh: 絕對真理、深信不疑的事

ex.en: Don't take everything online as gospel truth.
ex.zh: 別把網路上的一切都當成絕對真理。

ex.en: He treats his boss's words as gospel.
ex.zh: 他把老闆說的話當成金科玉律。

ex.en: Mikhail Gorbachev was the last leader of the Soviet Union.
ex.zh: 米哈伊爾·戈巴契夫是蘇聯的最後一任領導人。

ex.en: We learned about Gorbachev in our modern history class.
ex.zh: 我們在現代史課上學到了戈巴契夫。

ex.en: The city has a beautiful Gothic cathedral with tall towers.
ex.zh: 這座城市有一座擁有高塔的美麗哥德式大教堂。

ex.en: Gothic windows are tall and pointed at the top.
ex.zh: 哥德式的窗戶高而尖頂。

ex.en: The architect was famous for his use of Gothic in churches.
ex.zh: 那位建築師以在教堂中運用哥德風格聞名。

ex.en: Some people love the dark mood of Gothic in novels.
ex.zh: 有些人喜歡小說中哥德風格的陰暗氛圍。

ex.en: She wore a long red gown to the dance.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件紅色長禮服去參加舞會。

ex.en: The bride's wedding gown was made of white silk.
ex.zh: 新娘的婚紗是用白色絲綢做成的。

ex.en: The nurse helped him change into a hospital gown.
ex.zh: 護理師幫他換上病人服。

ex.en: Students wore a black gown at the graduation ceremony.
ex.zh: 學生在畢業典禮上穿著黑色學位袍。

ex.en: You look gorgeous in that dress!
ex.zh: 你穿那件洋裝美極了！

ex.en: The view from the hotel balcony was gorgeous.
ex.zh: 從飯店陽台看出去的景色美得令人讚嘆。

ex.en: It was a gorgeous day, so we had lunch outside.
ex.zh: 那天天氣好極了，所以我們在戶外吃午餐。

ex.en: We had gorgeous weather for the whole holiday.
ex.zh: 整個假期的天氣都好得不得了。

ex.en: A goose walked slowly across the grass beside the lake.
ex.zh: 一隻鵝在湖邊的草地上慢慢走過。

ex.en: We had roast goose for dinner on the holiday.
ex.zh: 假日的晚餐我們吃了烤鵝。

ex.en: Don't be a silly goose, of course I'm not angry with you.
ex.zh: 別傻了，我當然沒有在生你的氣。

ex.en: She laughed and called her little brother a silly goose.
ex.zh: 她笑著叫弟弟是個小傻瓜。

governing.zh: 治理、統治（govern 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The party has been governing the country for ten years.
ex.zh: 這個政黨已經執政這個國家十年了。

ex.en: Who is governing the city while the mayor is away?
ex.zh: 市長不在時，是誰在管理這座城市？

ex.en: The governing party lost several seats in the election.
ex.zh: 執政黨在選舉中失去了幾個席次。

ex.en: The school's governing board meets once a month.
ex.zh: 學校的管理委員會每月開會一次。

ex.en: The goalkeeper jumped and saved the penalty kick.
ex.zh: 守門員撲出去，擋下了這記十二碼罰球。

ex.en: Our goalkeeper is the tallest player on the team.
ex.zh: 我們的守門員是球隊裡最高的球員。

ex.en: My uncle is a keen golfer and plays every weekend.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是個熱衷的高爾夫球手，每個週末都打球。

ex.en: The golfer hit the ball straight down the fairway.
ex.zh: 那位球員把球直直打向球道。

ex.en: Gosh, I forgot my keys again!
ex.zh: 天啊，我又忘了帶鑰匙！

ex.en: Oh gosh, is it already midnight?
ex.zh: 哎呀，已經半夜了嗎？

ex.en: The goldsmith made a delicate ring by hand.
ex.zh: 金匠手工打造了一枚精巧的戒指。

ex.en: Her grandfather worked as a goldsmith for forty years.
ex.zh: 她的祖父當了四十年的金匠。

ex.en: Goodnight, sleep well and see you tomorrow!
ex.zh: 晚安，好好睡，明天見！

ex.en: She smiled and said goodnight to everyone at the party.
ex.zh: 她微笑著向派對上的每個人道晚安。

ex.en: The baby gorilla clung to its mother at the zoo.
ex.zh: 小猩猩在動物園裡緊緊抱著牠的媽媽。

ex.en: A gorilla can be very gentle even though it is huge.
ex.zh: 大猩猩雖然體型龐大，卻可以很溫和。

ex.en: In the fairy tale, a goblin hides gold under the mountain.
ex.zh: 在童話故事裡，有個小妖精把黃金藏在山底下。

ex.en: The children dressed up as a goblin for the school play.
ex.zh: 孩子們在學校的戲劇裡打扮成小妖精。

ex.en: A river runs through the deep gorge.
ex.zh: 一條河流過深深的峽谷。

ex.en: The hikers walked along the edge of the gorge.
ex.zh: 登山客沿著峽谷邊緣行走。

ex.en: The kids gorged themselves on cake at the party.
ex.zh: 孩子們在派對上狼吞虎嚥地吃蛋糕。

ex.en: After the long hike, we gorged on hot noodles.
ex.zh: 長途健行後，我們大口吃著熱騰騰的麵。

ex.en: The kids gobbled up their dinner in five minutes.
ex.zh: 孩子們五分鐘就把晚餐狼吞虎嚥吃完了。

ex.en: Don't gobble your food, or you'll get a stomachache.
ex.zh: 別狼吞虎嚥，不然你會肚子痛。

ex.en: We heard the gobble of a turkey on the farm.
ex.zh: 我們在農場聽到火雞的咯咯叫聲。

ex.en: The turkey let out a loud gobble at dawn.
ex.zh: 火雞在黎明發出響亮的咯咯聲。

ex.en: He put on his swimming goggles before jumping into the pool.
ex.zh: 他在跳進游泳池前戴上了蛙鏡。

ex.en: Safety goggles protect your eyes in the science lab.
ex.zh: 安全護目鏡能在實驗室裡保護你的眼睛。

ex.en: The children goggled at the huge cake.
ex.zh: 孩子們瞪大眼睛看著那個巨大的蛋糕。

ex.en: Don't just goggle at the screen all day.
ex.zh: 別整天只是瞪著螢幕看。

ex.en: Grandma brought a bag of goodies for the kids.
ex.zh: 奶奶帶了一袋好吃的東西給孩子們。

ex.en: The gift box was full of goodies from around the world.
ex.zh: 那個禮盒裡裝滿來自世界各地的好東西。

ex.en: Golfing is a popular weekend activity for my dad.
ex.zh: 打高爾夫球是我爸爸受歡迎的週末活動。

ex.en: We planned a golfing trip to the coast.
ex.zh: 我們計劃了一趟去海邊的高爾夫之旅。

ex.en: They are golfing at the new course today.
ex.zh: 他們今天正在新球場打高爾夫球。

ex.en: He met his boss while golfing on Sunday.
ex.zh: 他週日打高爾夫球時遇到了老闆。

ex.en: He made a goofy face to cheer up the baby.
ex.zh: 他扮了個鬼臉逗嬰兒開心。

ex.en: My dog looks goofy when it wears a hat.
ex.zh: 我的狗戴帽子時看起來傻傻的。

gogh.zh: 梵谷（荷蘭畫家 Van Gogh 的姓）

ex.en: Vincent van Gogh was a Dutch painter.
ex.zh: 文森·梵谷是荷蘭畫家。

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of van Gogh's paintings.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了大量梵谷的畫作。

ex.en: The knife slipped and gouged a deep line in the table.
ex.zh: 刀子滑了一下，在桌上刻出一道深痕。

ex.en: The tires gouged ruts in the soft ground.
ex.zh: 輪胎在鬆軟的地面壓出深深的車轍。

ex.en: Some shops gouge tourists by doubling the price.
ex.zh: 有些商店會把價格加倍來坑觀光客。

ex.en: Gas stations were accused of gouging drivers during the storm.
ex.zh: 加油站被指控在暴風雨期間趁機坑駕駛人。

ex.en: The kids got a bag of goodies at the party.
ex.zh: 孩子們在派對上拿到一袋好吃的小零食。

ex.en: Grandma packed some goodies for our trip.
ex.zh: 奶奶為我們的旅行準備了一些好吃的點心。

ex.en: Goody, we're having pizza tonight!
ex.zh: 太棒了，今晚吃披薩！

ex.en: Oh goody, the weekend is finally here.
ex.zh: 哇，太好了，週末終於到了。

ex.en: He asked his uncle to be the baby's godfather.
ex.zh: 他請叔叔當寶寶的教父。

ex.en: My godfather gave me a watch on my birthday.
ex.zh: 我的教父在我生日時送了我一只手錶。

ex.en: The goalie dived to stop the shot.
ex.zh: 守門員撲身擋下了那一球。

ex.en: Our goalie is only fifteen years old.
ex.zh: 我們的守門員才十五歲。

ex.en: The old man carried water in a dried gourd.
ex.zh: 老人用一個乾葫蘆裝水帶著走。

ex.en: She grew a large gourd in her garden this summer.
ex.zh: 她今年夏天在花園裡種了一顆大葫蘆。

gondola.zh: 貢多拉（威尼斯平底小船）

ex.en: We rode a gondola along the canals of Venice.
ex.zh: 我們坐貢多拉遊覽了威尼斯的運河。

ex.en: The gondola glided quietly under the old stone bridge.
ex.zh: 貢多拉安靜地滑過古老的石橋底下。

ex.en: The ski gondola carried us up to the top of the mountain.
ex.zh: 滑雪纜車載我們上到山頂。

ex.en: Six people can fit in one gondola.
ex.zh: 一節纜車車廂可以坐六個人。

ex.en: My godmother gave me a book on my birthday.
ex.zh: 我的教母在我生日時送了我一本書。

ex.en: She asked her friend to be the baby's godmother.
ex.zh: 她請朋友當寶寶的教母。

ex.en: His friends goaded him into jumping off the dock.
ex.zh: 朋友們慫恿他從碼頭跳下去。

ex.en: She was goaded by the criticism to work even harder.
ex.zh: 那些批評激得她更加努力。

ex.en: The farmer used a goad to move the cattle.
ex.zh: 農夫用趕牛棒驅趕牛群。

ex.en: Fear of failure was a goad that kept him studying.
ex.zh: 害怕失敗是促使他不斷讀書的動力。

ex.en: He raised his goblet and made a toast to the bride.
ex.zh: 他舉起高腳杯向新娘敬酒。

ex.en: A silver goblet stood on the table beside the candles.
ex.zh: 一只銀製高腳杯放在蠟燭旁的桌上。

ex.en: Some viewers dislike the gore in horror movies.
ex.zh: 有些觀眾不喜歡恐怖片裡血淋淋的畫面。

ex.en: The film was criticized for too much gore.
ex.zh: 這部電影因血腥場面過多而受到批評。

ex.en: The family hired a governess to teach the children at home.
ex.zh: 這個家庭請了一位女家教在家教孩子們。

ex.en: In the novel, a young governess arrives at a big old house.
ex.zh: 在小說裡，一位年輕的女家教來到一棟老舊的大宅。

ex.en: A wild gobbler strutted across the field.
ex.zh: 一隻野生的公火雞在田野上昂首闊步。

ex.en: Hunters listen for the call of a gobbler in the spring.
ex.zh: 獵人在春天會留意公火雞的叫聲。

ex.en: There was sticky goo all over the kitchen counter.
ex.zh: 廚房流理臺上到處是黏黏的東西。

ex.en: The kids played with green goo at the science fair.
ex.zh: 孩子們在科學展上玩綠色的黏液。

ex.en: Gonorrhoea is an infection that can be treated with antibiotics.
ex.zh: 淋病是一種可以用抗生素治療的感染。

ex.en: Health classes teach students how to prevent diseases like gonorrhoea.
ex.zh: 健康教育課教學生如何預防像淋病這樣的疾病。

ex.en: Don't be such a goof; just try it.
ex.zh: 別這麼傻了，試試看吧。

ex.en: He is a lovable goof who always makes us laugh.
ex.zh: 他是個討人喜歡的傻大個，總是逗我們笑。

ex.en: I goofed and sent the email to the wrong person.
ex.zh: 我搞砸了，把郵件寄給錯的人。

ex.en: Try not to goof up the order this time.
ex.zh: 這次別再把訂單搞砸了。

ex.en: He grew a goatee to look older.
ex.zh: 他留了山羊鬍讓自己看起來更成熟。

ex.en: The man with the gray goatee smiled at us.
ex.zh: 那位留著灰色山羊鬍的男士對我們微笑。

ex.en: A loud gong signaled the start of the ceremony.
ex.zh: 一聲響亮的鑼聲宣告典禮開始。

ex.en: The monk struck the gong three times.
ex.zh: 僧人敲了三下鑼。

ex.en: The shop owner hired a couple of goons to scare people.
ex.zh: 店主雇了幾個打手去嚇唬人。

ex.en: The movie's villain always sends his goons to do the dirty work.
ex.zh: 電影裡的反派總是派手下去幹髒活。

ex.en: Stop acting like a goon and listen to me.
ex.zh: 別再像個傻瓜一樣胡鬧，聽我說。

ex.en: My brother is such a goon when he tries to dance.
ex.zh: 我弟弟一跳舞就像個大傻瓜。

ex.en: I don't like gory horror movies.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡血腥的恐怖片。

ex.en: The report gave gory details of the accident.
ex.zh: 報導描述了意外現場血淋淋的細節。

ex.en: The gooey chocolate cake melted in my mouth.
ex.zh: 黏稠的巧克力蛋糕在我嘴裡化開。

ex.en: My hands got gooey from the melted candy.
ex.zh: 融化的糖果弄得我雙手黏答答的。

governorship.zh: 州長（或總督）的職位或任期

ex.en: He ran for the governorship of his home state.
ex.zh: 他參選了家鄉那個州的州長職位。

ex.en: During her governorship, the state built several new bridges.
ex.zh: 在她擔任州長期間，該州蓋了好幾座新橋。

ex.en: The extra money was a godsend for the family.
ex.zh: 這筆額外的錢對這個家庭來說是及時雨。

ex.en: The rain was a godsend after the long drought.
ex.zh: 久旱之後，這場雨真是天賜之福。

ex.en: She painted the poster with gouache.
ex.zh: 她用不透明水彩畫了那張海報。

ex.en: Gouache dries fast and has a matte finish.
ex.zh: 不透明水彩乾得快，成品是霧面的。

ex.en: Let's go over the contract once more before signing.
ex.zh: 簽約前我們再仔細檢查一次合約吧。

ex.en: The teacher went over my essay and marked a few mistakes.
ex.zh: 老師仔細看過我的作文，標出幾個錯誤。

ex.en: Can you go over the budget with me?
ex.zh: 你可以和我一起檢視這份預算嗎？

go over.en: to look at something carefully to check it

ex.en: I need to go over my notes before the test.
ex.zh: 考試前我得把筆記複習一遍。

ex.en: We went over yesterday's lesson at the start of class.
ex.zh: 上課一開始我們先複習了昨天的內容。

ex.en: Let's go over the new vocabulary one more time.
ex.zh: 我們把新單字再複習一次吧。

go over.en: to study or repeat something again to remember it

ex.en: Go over to the window and see what's happening outside.
ex.zh: 走到窗邊看看外面發生了什麼事。

ex.en: She went over to the new student and said hello.
ex.zh: 她走向新同學並打了招呼。

ex.en: Why don't you go over and introduce yourself?
ex.zh: 你何不過去自我介紹一下？

go over.en: to walk to a place or person

ex.en: If you want the last slice of pizza, go ahead.
ex.zh: 如果你想吃最後一片披薩，請便。

ex.en: Go ahead and ask her; she won't mind at all.
ex.zh: 儘管去問她，她一點都不會介意。

ex.en: You can go ahead and start eating without me.
ex.zh: 你們可以先開動，不用等我。

go ahead.en: used to tell someone they may do something

ex.en: The city decided to go ahead with the new bridge project.
ex.zh: 市政府決定繼續進行新橋樑的工程。

ex.en: The concert went ahead despite the light rain.
ex.zh: 儘管下著小雨，演唱會還是照常舉行。

ex.en: We will go ahead with the meeting once everyone arrives.
ex.zh: 等大家都到了，我們就開始開會。

go ahead.en: to begin or continue with a plan

ex.en: You go ahead; I'll catch up with you in a minute.
ex.zh: 你先走，我馬上就跟上。

ex.en: The guide went ahead to check whether the path was safe.
ex.zh: 嚮導先往前走，確認路徑是否安全。

ex.en: Please go ahead of me, since I am walking slowly today.
ex.zh: 請你走前面，因為我今天走得很慢。

go ahead.en: to move forward or leave before others

ex.en: Don't worry about the plan; we'll figure it out as we go along.
ex.zh: 別擔心計畫，我們邊做邊想辦法。

ex.en: She learned the rules as she went along.
ex.zh: 她一邊玩一邊學規則。

ex.en: I make up the recipe as I go along.
ex.zh: 我一邊煮一邊隨興調整食譜。

go along.en: to do something step by step while continuing

ex.en: We're going to the market, so come go along with us.
ex.zh: 我們要去市場，一起來吧。

ex.en: I'll go along to keep you company on the trip.
ex.zh: 我會一起去，陪你走這一趟。

ex.en: Why don't you go along with your sister to the park?
ex.zh: 你何不跟你姊姊一起去公園？

go along.en: to travel or attend together with someone

ex.en: I'm happy to go along with whatever you decide.
ex.zh: 不管你決定什麼，我都樂意配合。

ex.en: Most of the team went along with the new schedule.
ex.zh: 大部分的團隊成員都配合了新的時程。

ex.en: He didn't want to go along with their silly idea.
ex.zh: 他不想附和他們那個愚蠢的點子。

go along.en: to agree with a plan or idea

ex.en: Things are going along nicely at the new office.
ex.zh: 新辦公室的一切都進行得很順利。

ex.en: The project went along smoothly until the final week.
ex.zh: 這個專案一直進展順利，直到最後一週。

ex.en: The road goes along the river for several miles.
ex.zh: 這條路沿著河岸延伸好幾英里。

ex.en: Please go away; I'm trying to finish my homework.
ex.zh: 請走開，我正在努力寫完功課。

ex.en: The dog wouldn't go away until I gave it some food.
ex.zh: 那隻狗直到我給牠食物才肯走開。

ex.en: I hope this headache goes away soon.
ex.zh: 我希望這個頭痛趕快消失。

go away.en: to leave a place or stop bothering someone

ex.en: I forgot my keys, so I have to go back home.
ex.zh: 我忘了帶鑰匙，所以得回家一趟。

ex.en: They plan to go back to Tainan next summer.
ex.zh: 他們打算明年夏天回台南。

ex.en: After the break, everyone went back to work.
ex.zh: 休息過後，大家都回去工作了。

ex.en: This temple goes back more than three hundred years.
ex.zh: 這座廟的歷史可以追溯到三百多年前。

ex.en: Our friendship goes back to elementary school.
ex.zh: 我們的友誼可以追溯到小學時期。

ex.en: The tradition goes back to the early days of the town.
ex.zh: 這項傳統可以追溯到小鎮的早期。

go back.en: to have existed since a time in the past

ex.en: Let's go down the stairs and wait outside.
ex.zh: 我們下樓到外面等吧。

ex.en: The elevator is broken, so we have to go down on foot.
ex.zh: 電梯壞了，所以我們得走路下去。

ex.en: She went down the hill on her bike.
ex.zh: 她騎腳踏車下山。

go down.en: to move to a lower place

ex.en: Prices usually go down after the holiday season.
ex.zh: 假期過後，物價通常會下降。

ex.en: His fever went down after he took the medicine.
ex.zh: 他吃了藥以後，燒就退了。

ex.en: The number of visitors has gone down this year.
ex.zh: 今年的遊客人數減少了。

go down.en: to become lower in amount or level

ex.en: The sun goes down around six in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天太陽大約六點下山。

ex.en: The old ship went down during a terrible storm.
ex.zh: 那艘老船在一場可怕的暴風雨中沉沒了。

ex.en: We watched the sun go down behind the mountains.
ex.zh: 我們看著太陽落到山後。

go down.en: to sink below the horizon or under water

ex.en: The website went down for two hours last night.
ex.zh: 網站昨晚當機了兩個小時。

ex.en: The server always goes down when too many people log in.
ex.zh: 登入的人太多時，伺服器總是會掛掉。

ex.en: Nobody knows exactly what went down at the meeting.
ex.zh: 沒有人確切知道會議上發生了什麼事。

go down.en: to stop working, or to happen

ex.en: The bomb in the old movie went off right on time.
ex.zh: 老電影裡的炸彈準時爆炸了。

ex.en: Fireworks went off all over the city at midnight.
ex.zh: 午夜時，全城各處都響起煙火。

ex.en: The firecracker went off with a loud bang.
ex.zh: 鞭炮砰的一聲炸開了。

ex.en: My alarm clock goes off at six every morning.
ex.zh: 我的鬧鐘每天早上六點響。

ex.en: The smoke alarm went off while I was cooking.
ex.zh: 我煮飯時煙霧警報器響了。

ex.en: Her phone went off in the middle of the quiet lesson.
ex.zh: 在安靜的課堂上，她的手機突然響了。

go off.en: to make a sudden loud noise

ex.en: He went off to work without saying goodbye.
ex.zh: 他沒說再見就出門上班了。

ex.en: The children went off to play in the garden.
ex.zh: 孩子們跑去花園玩了。

ex.en: She went off in a hurry after the phone call.
ex.zh: 接完電話後她匆匆離開了。

ex.en: The milk has gone off, so please don't drink it.
ex.zh: 這牛奶已經壞了，請不要喝。

ex.en: Meat goes off quickly in hot weather.
ex.zh: 肉在炎熱的天氣裡很快就會變質。

ex.en: I think the cheese went off while we were away.
ex.zh: 我想我們不在家時起司就壞了。

go off.en: to become bad and no longer fit to eat

ex.en: Please go on; I'm very interested in your story.
ex.zh: 請繼續說，我對你的故事很有興趣。

ex.en: The meeting went on for almost three hours.
ex.zh: 會議持續了將近三個小時。

ex.en: She went on working even though it was late.
ex.zh: 雖然很晚了，她還是繼續工作。

go on.en: to continue doing or saying something

ex.en: What's going on in the next room?
ex.zh: 隔壁房間發生什麼事了？

ex.en: Nobody told me what was going on at the office.
ex.zh: 沒有人告訴我辦公室裡發生了什麼事。

ex.en: There is a lot going on in town this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個週末城裡有很多活動。

ex.en: Go on, try it; it tastes better than it looks.
ex.zh: 來嘛，試試看，它吃起來比看起來好吃。

ex.en: Go on, you can do it!
ex.zh: 加油，你做得到的！

ex.en: Go on, tell us what happened at the party.
ex.zh: 說吧，告訴我們派對上發生了什麼事。

go on.en: used to encourage someone to do something

ex.en: Let's go out for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 我們今晚出去吃晚餐吧。

ex.en: I don't like to go out when it's raining.
ex.zh: 下雨時我不喜歡出門。

ex.en: They went out for a walk after lunch.
ex.zh: 他們午餐後出去散步。

go out.en: to leave your home to do something outside

ex.en: He has been going out with her for two years.
ex.zh: 他和她交往兩年了。

ex.en: Do you want to go out with me this weekend?
ex.zh: 這個週末你想跟我出去約會嗎？

ex.en: My sister and her boyfriend went out for a long time.
ex.zh: 我姊姊和她男友交往了很久。

go out.en: to have a romantic relationship with someone

ex.en: The lights went out during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨期間燈熄滅了。

ex.en: Don't let the fire go out before morning.
ex.zh: 別讓火在早上之前熄掉。

ex.en: The candle went out when the window opened.
ex.zh: 窗戶一開，蠟燭就熄了。

ex.en: She went through a very hard time after moving abroad.
ex.zh: 她搬到國外後度過了一段很艱難的時期。

ex.en: Many families are going through the same problem.
ex.zh: 許多家庭正經歷同樣的問題。

ex.en: He has gone through a lot to reach this point.
ex.zh: 他歷經許多困難才走到這一步。

go through.en: to experience something difficult or unpleasant

ex.en: The teacher went through our essays line by line.
ex.zh: 老師逐行仔細檢查我們的作文。

ex.en: Customs officers went through all of his bags.
ex.zh: 海關人員翻查了他所有的行李。

ex.en: Let's go through the contract before we sign it.
ex.zh: 簽約前我們先把合約仔細看過一遍。

go through.en: to look at or search something carefully

ex.en: We went through three bags of rice this month.
ex.zh: 這個月我們用掉了三袋米。

ex.en: The new law finally went through last week.
ex.zh: 新法案上週終於通過了。

ex.en: His request went through without any problems.
ex.zh: 他的申請毫無問題地通過了。

go through.en: to be used up, or to be officially approved

ex.en: Let's go up to the roof and look at the stars.
ex.zh: 我們上屋頂看星星吧。

ex.en: She went up the stairs to get her coat.
ex.zh: 她上樓去拿外套。

ex.en: The kids went up to their rooms after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐後孩子們上樓回房間。

go up.en: to move to a higher place

ex.en: Rent has gone up again this year.
ex.zh: 今年房租又漲了。

ex.en: The temperature will go up to thirty degrees tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天氣溫會升到三十度。

ex.en: Food prices keep going up every month.
ex.zh: 食物價格每個月都在上漲。

go up.en: to rise in price, level or number

ex.en: A new shopping mall is going up near the station.
ex.zh: 車站附近正在蓋一座新的購物中心。

ex.en: Tall buildings have gone up all over the area.
ex.zh: 這一帶到處都蓋起了高樓。

ex.en: The new school went up in just six months.
ex.zh: 這所新學校只花六個月就蓋好了。

ex.en: The dog went after the ball.
ex.zh: 狗追著球跑。

ex.en: The police went after the car.
ex.zh: 警察追趕那輛車。

ex.en: She went after the job she wanted.
ex.zh: 她去爭取她想要的那份工作。

ex.en: Go after your dreams while you are young.
ex.zh: 趁年輕去追求你的夢想。

go after.en: to try to get something you want

ex.en: I'll go along with your plan.
ex.zh: 我會贊同你的計畫。

ex.en: He didn't want to go along with the group's decision.
ex.zh: 他不想順從大家的決定。

go along with.en: to agree with an idea or plan

ex.en: I'll go along with you to the doctor.
ex.zh: 我陪你一起去看醫生。

ex.en: She went along with her friends to the beach.
ex.zh: 她和朋友們一起去了海邊。

ex.en: I think I'll go for the chicken.
ex.zh: 我想我要點雞肉。

ex.en: She went for the cheaper phone.
ex.zh: 她選了比較便宜的那支手機。

ex.en: Let's go for a walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐後我們去散步吧。

ex.en: They went for a swim in the lake.
ex.zh: 他們去湖裡游泳。

go for.en: to go out to do an activity

ex.en: You should go for it and apply for that job.
ex.zh: 你應該放手一試，去應徵那份工作。

ex.en: The team is going for the championship this year.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍今年要爭取冠軍。

go for.en: to try hard to get or achieve something

ex.en: Let's go in out of the rain.
ex.zh: 我們進去躲雨吧。

ex.en: He went in and sat at the back of the room.
ex.zh: 他走進去，坐在房間後面。

ex.en: This key won't go in the lock.
ex.zh: 這把鑰匙插不進鎖孔。

ex.en: The big box didn't go in the trunk.
ex.zh: 大箱子放不進後車廂。

ex.en: Do you want me to go with you to the doctor?
ex.zh: 你要我陪你去看醫生嗎？

ex.en: My sister went with me to the night market.
ex.zh: 我姐姐跟我一起去了夜市。

go with.en: to travel or attend somewhere together with another person

ex.en: This red tie goes with your gray suit very well.
ex.zh: 這條紅領帶跟你的灰西裝很搭。

ex.en: White rice goes with almost any Taiwanese dish.
ex.zh: 白飯跟幾乎所有台灣菜都很搭。

go with.en: to look or taste good together with something else

ex.en: I'll go with the blue one, please.
ex.zh: 請給我藍色的那個。

ex.en: After a long talk, we decided to go with her plan.
ex.zh: 談了很久之後，我們決定採用她的計畫。

go with.en: to choose one option from several

ex.en: Time goes by quickly when you are having fun.
ex.zh: 玩得開心時，時間過得特別快。

ex.en: Several years went by before we met again.
ex.zh: 過了好幾年我們才再見面。

go by.en: to pass, when talking about time

ex.en: A red bus went by the window.
ex.zh: 一輛紅色公車從窗邊駛過。

ex.en: I go by the bakery every morning on my way to work.
ex.zh: 我每天早上上班都會經過那家麵包店。

go by.en: to pass a place or person while moving

ex.en: You can't go by the price alone when buying a laptop.
ex.zh: 買筆電不能只看價格。

ex.en: The referee went by the rules and gave a warning.
ex.zh: 裁判依照規則給了警告。

go by.en: to use something as a guide for a decision

ex.en: She goes by the name of Amy at work.
ex.zh: 她在公司都叫艾咪這個名字。

ex.en: The singer goes by a different name on stage.
ex.zh: 這位歌手在舞台上用另一個名字。

go by.en: to be known by a particular name

ex.en: We had to go without hot water for two days.
ex.zh: 我們有兩天沒有熱水可用。

ex.en: I can't go without coffee in the morning.
ex.zh: 我早上沒有咖啡就不行。

go without.en: to live or manage without something you need or want

ex.en: I cannot go into detail right now.
ex.zh: 我現在沒辦法詳細說明。

ex.en: The guide went into detail about the old temple.
ex.zh: 導覽員詳細介紹了這座古廟。

ex.en: Please go into detail when you describe the problem.
ex.zh: 描述問題時請說詳細一點。

go into detail.en: explain something fully with all the small facts

ex.en: The bus drivers went on strike yesterday.
ex.zh: 公車司機昨天罷工了。

ex.en: Workers may go on strike if their pay is cut.
ex.zh: 如果薪水被砍，員工可能會罷工。

ex.en: The teachers voted to go on strike.
ex.zh: 老師們投票決定罷工。

go on strike.en: stop working to protest about pay or conditions

ex.en: We went shopping for shoes on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我們星期六去買鞋子。

ex.en: Do you want to go shopping this afternoon?
ex.zh: 你今天下午想去逛街嗎？

ex.en: My mother goes shopping every Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 我媽媽每個星期天早上都去購物。

ex.en: I usually go to bed at eleven.
ex.zh: 我通常十一點上床睡覺。

ex.en: The kids went to bed after the story.
ex.zh: 聽完故事後孩子們就去睡覺了。

ex.en: You should go to bed early tonight.
ex.zh: 你今晚應該早點睡。

ex.en: My sister goes to school by bike.
ex.zh: 我妹妹騎腳踏車上學。

ex.en: He went to school in a small town.
ex.zh: 他在一個小鎮上學。

ex.en: Children must go to school until they are fifteen.
ex.zh: 孩子到十五歲前都必須上學。

ex.en: The baby went to sleep right after dinner.
ex.zh: 寶寶吃完晚飯後馬上就睡著了。

ex.en: I cannot go to sleep when it is noisy.
ex.zh: 吵的時候我睡不著。

ex.en: Turn off the light and go to sleep.
ex.zh: 把燈關掉睡覺吧。

ex.en: He goes to work by train every day.
ex.zh: 他每天搭火車上班。

ex.en: I went to work early to finish my report.
ex.zh: 我提早上班把報告做完。

ex.en: She does not go to work on weekends.
ex.zh: 她週末不用上班。

go to work.en: travel to your job or begin working

ex.en: Something went wrong with my computer.
ex.zh: 我的電腦出了點問題。

ex.en: The plan could go wrong if it rains.
ex.zh: 如果下雨，這個計畫可能會出問題。

ex.en: Everything went wrong on the first day.
ex.zh: 第一天什麼事都不順。

ex.en: We went wrong at the second corner.
ex.zh: 我們在第二個轉角走錯了路。

ex.en: Where did I go wrong in this math problem?
ex.zh: 我這題數學哪裡做錯了？

ex.en: It is easy to go wrong without a map.
ex.zh: 沒有地圖很容易走錯路。

go wrong.en: take a wrong way or make a mistake

ex.en: If you want to join the team, go for it!
ex.zh: 如果你想加入球隊，就放手去做吧！

ex.en: You have a good idea, so go for it.
ex.zh: 你的點子很好，就去做吧。

go for it.en: used to encourage someone to try hard to get what they want

ex.en: Our team will go all out to win the final game.
ex.zh: 我們的隊伍會全力以赴贏得決賽。

ex.en: She went all out to make her mother's birthday special.
ex.zh: 她盡全力讓媽媽的生日很特別。

go all out.en: to try as hard as you can

ex.en: You passed the test? Good for you!
ex.zh: 你通過考試了？真棒！

ex.en: "I started running every morning." "Good for you, keep it up."
ex.zh: 「我開始每天早上跑步。」「很棒，繼續保持。」

good for you.en: used to praise someone or show you are happy for them

ex.en: Eating vegetables is good for you.
ex.zh: 吃蔬菜對你有好處。

ex.en: Sleeping early is good for you, especially during exams.
ex.zh: 早睡對你有益，尤其是考試期間。

ex.en: Let's go Dutch, since we both ordered a lot.
ex.zh: 我們各付各的吧，我們兩個都點很多。

ex.en: On our first date, we decided to go Dutch.
ex.zh: 第一次約會時，我們決定各付各的。

go dutch.en: to share a bill so each person pays for themselves
